transcriber_notes: PDF wraps two raster strips (900x500 above 900x307) of one niViz chart on a rotated page; measured on the stitched embedded rasters (task render showed the same crop). Header top and chart bottom (below ~3 cm, including the temperature axis labels) are cropped in the source. Height axis 4.62 px/cm (grid every 20 cm): boundaries from bar edges and leader lines, +-0.5 cm (128,124,109,75,54,31,13). Hardness from the R column, consistent with bar ends. A red snow-temperature line is drawn (from ~128 cm down past the crop) but the temperature axis labels are cropped away, so no temperatures were recorded (other niViz charts use -20..0 C on the same grid, but that scale is not printed here). No date or site printed on the visible chart.
